market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI peaked at ~$110 in May, currently ~$93-100 amid US-Iran de-escalation. To reach $115 by end-June requires a ~15% rebound and likely a Hormuz re-escalation. Goldman/EIA forecasts have Brent peaking near $115 (so WTI around $103). $115 WTI is plausible only in a renewed supply shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Geopolitical re-escalation and OPEC+ production decisions
